{{Quote|This is very impressive, Senator Nudo, but let us see what results all this yields.|Count Dooku, on Skytop Station|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref>}}
'''Po Nudo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] politician, serving as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the Republic's [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Nudo withdrew the planets he represented from the Republic and pledged allegiance to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Appointed as a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and head of the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]], Nudo and his fellow Councilors led the Confederacy to war in a conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following three years of bloody conflict with the Republic, Nudo and the rest of the Council were [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassinated]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

==Biography==
[[File:Aqualish_senators.png|thumb|left|180px|Po Nudo in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].]]

A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], Po Nudo was an opposition [[Senator/Legends|senator]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Nudo represented the Ando and the Aqualish people of the planet in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="db" /> He also worked to ensure that commerce was maintained across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Nudo was one of many supporters gathered by Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="CSWE2" /> and the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> during the [[Local year|years]] leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|394|Nudo, Po}}</ref> During the last term of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], Nudo vocally opposed Chancellor Valorum's proposed taxation of the until then free trade zones. In addition to the proposal, Palpatine suggested that a part of the collected money could be invested in the growth of planetary systems in the affected areas. While senators of that region supported the idea, Nudo and other delegates, including [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] and [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], were openly opposed to it.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

The following year, Chancellor Valorum lost a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] against his rule and was swiftly replaced by Palpatine himself. Despite the [[Human/Legends|Human's]] popularity, Nudo became disillusioned with the Republic and became caught up in the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secessionist movement]] sweeping the Senate. Along with [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] Senator Toonbuck Toora, Nudo rendered his vote of [[Secession of Ando|secession]] to the Senate via droid proxy and swiftly departed the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] and headed for Ando.<ref name="Hnn-Ando, Sy Myrth Secede">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Nudo was invited to a clandestine meeting on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] where he was to meet with [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Attended by his aides of office, [[Nank Tun/Legends|one of which]] was a [[Shi'ido]] [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] in disguise, Nudo was joined by various other secessionist leaders, and quickly threw support behind Dooku's Confederacy; together they declared war on the Republic and amassed the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Most honored Count, Skytop Station is fully active! Only my contacts in the communications cartel could make such a marvel possible. We can intercept and analyze ''countless'' HoloNet transmissions. We are the ''ultimate'' listening post for this ''entire'' quadrant.|Po Nudo to Count Dooku|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Prelude" />}}
[[File:Po_Nudo_-_Dooku.png|thumb|right|180px|Nudo guides [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] through [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]].]]

As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Nudo was appointed as chairperson of the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]] by [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. As leader of the Confederacy's equivalent of the Republic's [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], Nudo was given a seat on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Council]] which guided the Confederacy. As part of the cartel, Nudo funded the construction of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] deep in the [[Ruusan system/Legends|Ruusan system]]. When the station was complete and fully operational, Nudo toured the facility with Count Dooku and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Prelude" /> Despite the security on the station, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were able to infiltrate the facility with a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and eventually destroy the space station from the inside out.<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>

As the war dragged on, Ando was gripped by [[Battle of Ando|civil war]] and Nudo was forced to follow the other Councilors around the galaxy in an effort to avoid capture under the protection of [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Joining the Council aboard the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], the leadership of the Confederacy was sent to the sinkhole world [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to await further instructions. Following Dooku's death over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at one of the most tumultuous [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battles]] of the war, Nudo was present with the other Councilors at the meeting during which Grievous ordered them to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], a mining planet on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] where they were promised safety. Not long after departing Utapau, Grievous was killed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the Council took full control over the Confederacy.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:Nudodies.png|thumb|left|250px|Po Nudo was eventually slain on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]
As the Council arrived on Mustafar, they quickly settled into the dimly lit command center at the mountainside [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]]. Nudo and the other Confederacy leaders were pressed into work at the facility's command center, supervising strategy and battle plans from their remote sanctuary. During their stay, the Council received a communications from the mysterious [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the Confederacy's shadowy benefactor. Sidious promised that the war was over and that the Republic had crumbled under the Separatist's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|war machine]]. Advising the Council to remain on the planet, Sidious assured them that he would send his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to watch over them. Relieved by the news of victory, Nudo and the others anxiously awaited for Vader's arrival and their eventual departure from the inhospitable world. Upon Vader's landing, the Council and its aides gathered in the facility's main command center to greet Vader only to realize soon after he sealed off all of the exits to the facility that he was not there to protect them. Igniting his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Vader savagely cut down the guards flanking the doorway before attacking the unarmed Councilors and their aides. Despite Nudo's protective breastplate, Vader's swift strikes with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] were enough to end the Aqualish's life.<ref name="ROTS" /> Soon after his death, the Hyper-Communications Cartel crumbled and disappeared.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PoNudoCrop-MF56.png|thumb|right|200px|Po Nudo was played by an unknown actor in Episodes I and II.]]
Using an Aqualish mask with four eyes instead of the two eyes seen on members of the same species such as [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]], Nudo's species was retconned as a mutated subspecies of Aqualish called the [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]]. In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], Nudo was played by [[Paul Nicholson]]<ref name="Being Po Nudo">{{HBCite|95}}</ref> although in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> as well as in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], he was played by an unknown extra.<ref name="AOTC" />
